# process_reads.R

## process_reads()

```{r}
QC_thresholds <- list(
  min_barcode_reads = 5,
  min_read_quality = 30,
  min_start_position_reads = 500,
  paired_readnames = TRUE
)

process_reads(
  source_dir = "data",
  sample_name = "MB_barcoded",
  amplicon_gRNA_number = 1,
  amplicon_data_file_name = "amplicons_barcoded_data.txt",
  HDR_barcoded_file_name = "HDR_file_barcoded_with_amplicon_sequences.csv",
  cell_to_UTR_BCs_file_name = "cell_to_UTR_barcode_system.csv",
  QC_thresholds = QC_thresholds,
  output_dir = "data",
  verbose = TRUE
)
```

```{r}
amplicon_data <- read.table("data/amplicons_barcoded_data.txt", header = TRUE)

HDR_barcoded_outcomes <- read.csv("data/HDR_file_barcoded_with_amplicon_sequences_Sho.csv", 
                                  header = TRUE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
```

```{r}
reads_classified_MB_barcoded_HDR_1 <- read.csv(
  "data/reads_classified_MB_barcoded_HDR_1.csv")

reads_classified_MB_barcoded_HDR_1$HDR_1 <- factor(
  reads_classified_MB_barcoded_HDR_1$HDR_1, levels = c("WT", "HDR_1"))

reads_classified_MB_barcoded_HDR_1_WT <- reads_classified_MB_barcoded_HDR_1 %>% 
  dplyr::filter(HDR_1 == "WT")

reads_classified_MB_barcoded_HDR_1_HDR <- reads_classified_MB_barcoded_HDR_1 %>% 
  dplyr::filter(HDR_1 == "HDR_1")
```


```{r}
table(reads_classified_MB_barcoded_HDR_1$HDR_1, useNA = "always")

barplot <- ggplot(reads_classified_MB_barcoded_HDR_1, aes(x = HDR_1, fill = HDR_1)) +
  geom_bar(width = 0.6, color = "black", alpha = 0.8) +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set2", na.value = "grey80") +
  labs(
    title = "Read Classification Count for HDR1", 
    x = "Classification", 
    y = "Count",
    fill = NULL
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16, hjust = 0.5),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 12, hjust = 0.5),
    axis.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "right",
    legend.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_line(color = "grey90", size = 0.3),
    panel.grid.minor.y = element_line(color = "grey95", size = 0.2)
  )

ggsave(file.path("plots/barplot.png"),
       plot = barplot,
       width = 5, height = 7, dpi = 300)
```

```{r}
# Remove NAs
reads_classified_MB_barcoded_HDR_1_NAremoved <- reads_classified_MB_barcoded_HDR_1 %>% 
  dplyr::filter(HDR_1 != "NA")

n1_hist <- ggplot(data = reads_classified_MB_barcoded_HDR_1_NAremoved, aes(x = n_1, fill = HDR_1)) + 
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set2") +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 1, position = "stack", color = "black", alpha = 0.8) +
  labs(
    title = "process_barcodes(): HDR1", 
    subtitle = "Distribution of the Number of Reads for Each Barcode",
    x = "Number of Reads", 
    y = "Frequency",
    fill = NULL
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16, hjust = 0.5),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 12, hjust = 0.5),
    axis.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "right",
    panel.grid.major.y = element_line(color = "grey90", size = 0.3),
    panel.grid.minor.y = element_line(color = "grey95", size = 0.2)
  )

ggsave(file.path("plots/n1_histogram.png"),
       plot = n1_hist,
       width = 8, height = 4, dpi = 300)
```

```{r}
pct1_hist <- ggplot(data = reads_classified_MB_barcoded_HDR_1_NAremoved, aes(x = pct_1, fill = HDR_1)) + 
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set2") +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 2, position = "stack", color = "black", alpha = 0.8) +
  labs(
    title = "process_barcodes(): HDR1", 
    subtitle = "Distribution of the Proportion of Barcodes that match each Classification",
    x = "Percentage", 
    y = "Frequency",
    fill = NULL
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16, hjust = 0.5),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 12, hjust = 0.5),
    axis.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "right",
    panel.grid.major.y = element_line(color = "grey90", size = 0.3),
    panel.grid.minor.y = element_line(color = "grey95", size = 0.2)
  )

ggsave(file.path("plots/pct1_histogram.png"),
       plot = pct1_hist,
       width = 8, height = 4, dpi = 300)
```
